entities.summary: Shinya Yamada (b. 1970-01-13, Hadano) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Hadano and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
